title: No Carrots
description: This mod removes all carrots from Minecraft, so you can’t farm them, find them, or use them for breeding or crafting. It wipes out a major early-game food and farming option.
body: No Carrots deletes every carrot-related feature: normal carrots, golden carrots, carrot drops, carrot-on-a-stick, and carrot crops. Villagers won’t farm them, mobs won’t drop them, and chests won’t generate them. This removes one of the best food items in the game (golden carrots), breaks pig breeding, and makes farming weaker overall. It makes survival harder, villages less useful, and late-game food a lot more limited.
